status_note: Frozen 2026-11-05 after author approval in chat ("Freeze as drafted"). Definitions, gates, sample sizes and namespaces are fixed. SHA-256 of this file is in protocol.sha256.
drafted_by: Claude Code (Opus 5.5); design decisions by the author

seed.unused_check: no occurrence in repository or local Codex output folders, 2026-11-05

hypotheses.H-S: Plug-in susceptibility fails at L4 T1.5; symmetry-aware S and generic ensemble G give calibrated intervals in all nine exact-reference cells
hypotheses.H-L: Short-batch BM under-covers at long tau; BM, OBM, SV-B, SV-TH (b=512) and GEYER are calibrated at n=8192 for tau<=19
hypotheses.H-D: Geyer-tau batch-length diagnostic abstains or yields calibrated adaptive intervals for every AR(1) setting; split-Rhat flags Ising sign non-mixing at L4 T1.5

definitions.susceptibility_estimand: chi = (N/T) Var_pi(m) = Var_pi(M)/(N T); m = M/N; zero field; periodic; J=kB=1
definitions.P: per-chain plug-in (N/T)(mean m^2 - (mean m)^2); reproduce only
definitions.S: per-chain (N/T) mean m^2; assumes exact E[m]=0 (global flip symmetry, h=0); interval BM 16 batches (b=96 of 1536), t15
definitions.G: ensemble of K=16 chains; theta=(N/T)(mean_i A_i - (mean_i B_i)^2); delete-one-chain jackknife bias correction and SE; t15
definitions.chi_abs_secondary: (N/T)(E[m^2] - E[|m|]^2), different estimand, per-chain plug-in, no gate

lrv_estimators.OBM: n b/((n-b)(n-b+1)) sum_{j=1}^{n-b+1} (Ybar_j(b) - xbar)^2; t_nu, nu=1.5 n/b
lrv_estimators.GEYER: initial positive then monotone sequence, rnglab12.uncertainty._geyer; z

diagnostic.tau_hat: GEYER tau on the same series
diagnostic.adaptive_b: smallest power of two in [16, n/16] with b >= 10*tau_hat; none -> RUN_TOO_SHORT, abstain
diagnostic.convergence: rank-normalized split-Rhat (Vehtari et al. 2021) per 16-chain ensemble for m, m^2, e; NOT_CONVERGED if > 1.01

ising.ensembles: consecutive groups of 16 chain ids; 2048 per cell

ar1.model: x_t = phi x_{t-1} + sqrt(1-phi^2) eps_t, x_1 ~ N(0,1), eps iid N(0,1), numpy default_rng

analysis.variance_ratio: mean estimated variance / empirical variance across units; percentile bootstrap 2000, seed rnglab-v018-estimators/analysis/bootstrap/<endpoint>
analysis.exclusions: none; abstentions counted; numerical failures count as non-coverage and are reported

failure_reproduction.S-F1: ising L4 T1.5, P: relative mean-bias CI upper < -0.5
failure_reproduction.L-F1: ar1 phi=0.99 n=8192 BM(32): coverage CP95 upper < 0.92
failure_reproduction.L-F2: ar1 phi=0.997 n=8192 BM(32): coverage CP95 upper < 0.92
failure_reproduction.D-F1: ising L4 T1.5 split-Rhat(m) NOT_CONVERGED fraction over 2048 ensembles: CP95 lower >= 0.90

control_validity.L-C: every (phi, n): bootstrap CI of empirical/exact Var(xbar) contains 1; t-CI of mean xbar contains 0
control_validity.S-C: every Ising cell: relative mean-bias CI of chain-mean energy within [-0.01, 0.01]

L-D.rule: k>=2048 non-abstaining: CP95 within [0.92,0.98] pass/fail; 200<=k<2048: fail if CP95 upper < 0.92 else inconclusive; k<200: not evaluable

verdicts.H-S: S-F1 reproduces and all S-S and S-G pass
verdicts.H-L: L-F1 and L-F2 reproduce and all L-A and L-G pass
verdicts.H-D: D-F1 holds, no L-D fails, and each family has at least one evaluable passing L-D gate

secondary: all methods and b at phi in {0.99, 0.997}: coverage, variance ratio, ESS-hat/true ESS
tau_hat/tau_n distributions; diagnostic status and abstention rates
Ising S with OBM, SV-TH, GEYER and adaptive intervals; diagnostic status of m^2 series
split-Rhat of m, m^2, e in all cells (specificity descriptive)
chi_abs against exact; P bias in all nine cells
excluded: re-analysis of Phase II PIMC traces (seen data)
references: Meketon & Schmeiser 1984, Proc. Winter Simulation Conference 227-230
Vehtari et al. 2021, Bayesian Analysis 16(2) 667-718, doi:10.1214/20-BA1221

approval.by: author (Hevele Imre Robert), in the Claude Code session

choices.5_regression_reference: constants in the test, citing the off-repo file and its SHA-256

implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.note: Operational details not specified in the draft; fixed here before any campaign draw; no gate or endpoint changes.
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.storage: Ising: per-chain integer total magnetization M (int8) and total energy E (int16) for all 2048 sweeps, one compressed NPZ per cell, kept outside Git under research/v018-estimators/traces/ (gitignored) with SHA-256 in the run manifest. AR(1): per-replica estimator outputs saved; traces regenerable from seeds.
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.geyer_undefined: If GEYER returns INVALID_LONG_RUN_VARIANCE, the GEYER interval counts as non-coverage (numerical failure) and the diagnostic for that series abstains with status TAU_UNDEFINED, reported separately.
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.split_rhat_ties: average ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata method="average") before the normal-score transform
implementation_notes_added_at_freeze.parallelism: 3 worker processes, one task per cell or (phi, n) setting; results do not depend on scheduling
